'''Gevin Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Gevin led a squad on a mission to destroy the Ulgo dam's generators, but were ambushed and betrayed by an Imperial. He tasked an Imperial spacer to set charges on the dam's generators inside [[Lerantha Dam]].
